segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including one with eczema and acne who says other new skincare usually burns or causes a rash within minutes, report this mask does not irritate them and leaves skin hydrated and glowing; one reviewer without a stated skin type found it left an unpleasant sticky feeling and cautions it may not suit sensitive skin.

concerns.dehydration: This is the effect nearly every reviewer reports success with: skin feeling notably softer, plumper, hydrated and glowing right after use, in some cases for several days afterward; a couple of reviewers temper this, saying the moisturized feeling isn't as strong as with higher-end masks, and one reviewer felt sticky rather than moisturized and was disappointed.
concerns.aging: Several reviewers report tighter-looking skin, less noticeable pores and a more even tone after use, including one describing a 'glass skin' finish within a couple of hours; no reviewer reports a longer-term change in wrinkles specifically.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers describe the chilled mask as cooling and soothing, including one using it to calm skin after sun exposure, and one with reactive skin who says other new products usually cause a rash or burning while this one did not.

extraits.texte: In the beginning I felt a bit itchy feeling. I didn’t think about it much. Very jello-y or slimy to go on. Slips out of your hands. It is white once on then turns clear after 2 hours. It felt hard or stiff once dry. It felt good going on but when you peel it off felt like a nose strip being peeled off. My skin feels sticky, I thought I would feel moisturized or like new. No. Sadly disappointed. Skin feels like I need to wash it out now. But if have sensitive skin this might not be for you.

What a great deal for probably the coolest face mask I have ever tried! I am middle aged and have eczema, acne and obviously wrinkles ha! Most of the time when I try new skincare items they immediately burn my sensitive skin or cause a rash within minutes. Not this bada** mask. It’s like a magic trick! 🪄 You put it on, smooth it over your skin, sit back, relax and it vanishes! That’s how you know it’s time to remove. It disappears and feels taut on your skin. Then you just move your face a bit to loosen and peel it off revealing hydrated skin. It didn’t reach to the top of my forehead or around my nose so I tore the mask a little to make it fit better and used the eye and nose pieces to fill in the gaps. I do wish this came in a long face/big forehead size. I can feel how dry my skin is where the mask was not. I left it on for about an hour while I took some me time, listening to my book and sipping spa water. Ahhhh This is just so cool I’ll be sharing with my sisters so they can try it. It really works and it’s really affordable.

extraits.titre: Incredible results, just wish it fit better and stayed on
extraits.texte: I have been looking into getting face masks for a while and decided on these because of the price, quantity and ingredients. The mask doesn't fit my face properly (too small), is very slippery and didn't stay put until I laid down, even then it kept slipping. The reason I gave this 4 stars is because afterwards my skin felt incredible! My skin was tightened, hydrated and had a glassy look to it. They didn't tear and held up really well, just wish they were slightly bigger. I did notice that my pores were less noticeable, which I love! If you're looking for something that's hassle free, I do not recommend, but if you're looking for good results, get them! I will be keeping these in my rotation.

I’m a big fan of this style mask so I’ve tried quite a few over the years. It has a light, not overpowering fragrance and left my skin feeling well moisturized. The 8-pack is a great value but I do wish the boxes were easier to separate without ripping the boxes so the multiple packs could be gifted. The major takeaways for me are that they didn’t irritate my sensitive skin, left my skin with a ‘glow’ for several days after each use as well as feeling much softer and well moisturized, and were much easier to put on than most because of the two piece design.

At this price point I truly wasn’t expecting much, but they aren’t bad. Not the best mask I’ve used, but not the worst either. They do dry to a more translucent opacity, but give yourself about 30 minutes if you have a hard time seeing the difference. (See photos) When it’s done and you take it off, you don’t get that same moisturized feel you get from higher quality masks. It’s not dry, you can feel how soft your skin is when you touch it. My skin feels tighter and a bit more evenly toned with a slight sheen. I do put a moisturizer on after, but I’m not sure it’s needed. For the amount you get and the price you pay, these are surprisingly pretty good masks.
Glass skin after couple of hours using this mask. It worked great for someone who has sensitive skin like myself. Highly recommended and reasonably priced

extraits.texte: These masks feel incredibly comfortable on my skin, especially after keeping them in the refrigerator. Using one after spending time in the sun feels so cooling and soothing, and my skin feels refreshed and well hydrated afterward. They've become one of my favorite ways to calm my skin at the end of the day.
